assets.prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Generate an original production-ready raster title logo for a charming gothic sports videogame, exact text "CRYPT GAMES" on two compact lines, CRYPT above GAMES, centered and exceptionally legible. Genuine 16-bit SNES-era pixel art, visibly crisp square pixel clusters, handcrafted stepped outlines, no vector curves or smooth anti-aliasing, no blur. Chunky custom carved ivory stone letters with pale golden bevel highlights, deep plum indigo extruded shadows, narrow aged brass outlines and small turquoise gems. A small friendly carved skull centered above the lettering and tiny symmetrical stone wing flourishes; restrained torch-amber highlights. Fits a game of squat gold-armored athletes playing sports in a purple-stone medieval crypt. Bold silhouette, collectible cartridge title-screen quality, sophisticated and playful rather than horror gore. Wide compact emblem occupying most of the canvas with tight transparent margins, horizontal overall silhouette about 3:1 despite stacked words. Text must be exactly CRYPT GAMES, no tagline, no additional text, no trademark, no frame, no background. Real alpha transparency. Intended display 300x100 pixels; prioritize readability at that size.
